newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Syrian vice-president in Bahrain for talks.
newsitem.headline: Syrian vice-president in Bahrain for talks.

text.p: Syrian Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam arrived in Bahrain on Wednesday as part of a Gulf tour to seek support for Syria's stand in the Middle East peace process.
Bahrain's official Gulf News Agency said Khaddam, accompanied by Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara, arrived for two days of talks.
Earlier in the day in Muscat, he urged Arab states to pressure Israel into abiding by previous agreements.

The two senior Syrian officials are touring the region to drum up support for Syria's stand after Israel and the PLO settled their deadlock on the West Bank town of Hebron this month, Gulf Arab newspapers have said.
Their regional swing has included Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and the United Arab Emirates.
